description: This file defines the SmsMessage entity class used for representing outbound SMS messages within the Fineract platform, including methods for creating instances and updating message content.

classes.name: SmsMessage
classes.description: Entity class representing an outbound SMS message, with fields for message details, status, associated entities, and static factory methods for creating instances.

methods.name: pendingSms
methods.description: Creates a new SmsMessage instance with status set to pending.

methods.name: sentSms
methods.description: Creates a new SmsMessage instance with status set to waiting for delivery report.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Creates a new SmsMessage instance with specified status.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the message content if changed, based on a JsonCommand.
